evidence.text: Hochelaga, Land of Souls is a 2017 Canadian historical drama film directed and written by François Girard and starring Gilles Renaud, Samian and Tanaya Beatty.

evidence.title: Hochelaga, Land of Souls
evidence.text: Dramatizing several centuries of Quebec history and the local history of Montreal in particular, the story depicts Quebec archaeology revealing the past of indigenous peoples, explorers and 1837 rebels.

evidence.title: Hochelaga, Land of Souls
evidence.text: Girard had previously used an anthology approach in his films such as" The Red Violin", and was interested in another project that would depict Montreal.

evidence.title: Hochelaga, Land of Souls
evidence.text: It was shot in Montreal, with performances in numerous languages.

evidence.title: Hochelaga, Land of Souls
evidence.text: The film was screened in the Gala Presentations section at the 2017 Toronto International Film Festival.

evidence.title: Hochelaga, Land of Souls
evidence.text: It won four Canadian Screen Awards, including Best Cinematography for Nicolas Bolduc, and was Canada's submission for the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film.

evidence.text: François Girard( born January 12, 1963) is a French- Canadian director and screenwriter.

evidence.title: François Girard
evidence.text: Born in Quebec, Girard's career began on the Montreal art video circuit.

evidence.title: François Girard
evidence.text: In 1990, he produced his first feature film," Cargo"; he attained international recognition following his 1993" Thirty Two Short Films About Glenn Gould", a series of vignettes about the life of piano prodigy Glenn Gould.

evidence.title: François Girard
evidence.text: In 1998, he wrote and directed" The Red Violin", which follows the ownership of a red violin over several centuries.

evidence.title: François Girard
evidence.text: " The Red Violin" won an Academy Award for Best Original Score, thirteen Genie Awards and nine Jutra Awards.

evidence.title: François Girard
evidence.text: He has also directed various works for the stage, including Stravinsky's" Symphony of PsalmsOedipus Rex" and" Novencento" at the Edinburgh International Festival; Kafka's" The Trial", adapted for the stage by Serge Lamothe at the National Arts Centre, Ottawa; the oratorio" Lost Objects" at the Brooklyn Academy of Music;" Siegfried" in Toronto; and" The Lindbergh Flight" and" The Seven Deadly Sins", first in Lyon and then in Edinburgh.

evidence.title: François Girard
evidence.text: Girard has also produced a residency show for Cirque du Soleil," Zed", in Tokyo and" Zarkana", which opened at Radio City Music Hall in New York in the summer of 2011.

evidence.title: François Girard
evidence.text: In 2013 the Metropolitan Opera in New York opened a new production of Richard Wagner's" Parsifal" directed by Girard.

evidence.title: François Girard
